name: shokunin
description: Shokunin — the craft posture for improvement rounds: one axis-move per round, per-axis judge verdicts instead of scalar scores, strict Pareto admission, honest stops.

interface.shortDescription: Craft discipline for improvement rounds — verdicts, not scores
interface.longDescription: A working stance for any agent improving a codebase, corpus, or skill: map the optimization space into objective and subjective axes, move ONE axis per round, and let the judge rule per axis — improved / harmed / unchanged / unprovable-but-better. Admission is strict Pareto: at least one axis improved, none harmed. Improvement is empirical proof where measurable, judged-better-vs-previous where not. No 1-10 scores, ever. Distilled from the shokunin craft fleet's charter and hardened in live self-improvement runs.
